== Summary ==
Slip “•Captain Han Solo” cut unchanged from page 7 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 222, 581, 497)). Version [[Captain Han Solo (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
